title: How much sugar for bee syrup? 1:1 and 2:1 made easy
summary: Thick 2:1 syrup for autumn, thin 1:1 for spring: Hive Pal's free syrup calculator tells you exactly how much sugar and water to mix for the amount you need. Ten litres of thick syrup takes almost nine kilos of sugar and four and a half litres of water.
